pkgmetadata.longdescription: muffin-databases provides async database support for the Muffin ASGI framework via the databases library, with optional backends for PostgreSQL (asyncpg), MySQL (aiomysql), and SQLite (aiosqlite).

use.flag: Enable MySQL/MariaDB async support via aiomysql
Enable PostgreSQL async support via asyncpg
Enable SQLite async support via aiosqlite
